note: The source of office/chair/*.svg (python tools/build_chair.py). Each chair is a grid of cells (`w` x `h`) and, for each of its two tones, rectangles `[x, y, width, height]` of cells (the tones do not overlap). `posts` is the lighter tone (the posts, the top rail and, on the empty chair, the seat and the front legs), `panel` the darker one (the back between the posts, under the rail). `back` is an occupied chair's back alone (the head stands over it, 22 x 12; `big` 26 x 14, for the open leader); `empty` is the whole chair with nobody on it (18 x 18). Drawn from Orkboard's mockup docs/mockups/lens-heads/ (`chairSvg`), decisions 201.
